exposure: exercise interventions (walking, aerobic, strength-conditioning, relaxation exercises) during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 170 IVF-pregnant women, divided into intervention and control groups.
finding: A significantly lower gestational diabetes and preeclampsia rate was found in IVF-pregnant women who maintained an active lifestyle with exercise interventions.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed in cesarean section rates between the intervention and control groups.
